sentences.en: There are lots of signs warning that they prosecute shoplifters.
sentences.zh: 有很多告示警告他们会对商店扒手进行起诉。

sentences.en: The store has caught several shoplifters recently.
sentences.zh: 这家店最近抓了好几个小偷。

sentences.en: Police arrested the shoplifter trying to steal some cosmetics.
sentences.zh: 警察抓住了一个试图偷化妆品的窃贼。
